newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Petrobras Q1 net slips - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Petrobras Q1 net slips - report.

text.p: Brazilian state oil monopoly Petrobras reported a net profit of 72 million reais in the first quarter, compared with 79 million reais in the same three-month period last year, a local news agency said.

InvestNews, citing company officials, said the 8.8 percent decline in the result was due mainly to a drop in product prices and December's reduction in subsidies from the government. Company officials could not be reached to confirm the figures or the explanation.

The agency also said gross sales in the first three months of 1997 reached 6.5 billion reais versus 5.2 billion reais in the same period last year. Net sales reached 4.1 billion reais compared with 3.8 billion reais in the same period last year.
The company's net earnings amounted to 0.66 reais per lot of 1,000 shares, it said.
